`first-bazaar-author-preparation.json` is the actual public preparation emitted
offline by the original author tool at source
`afa6d07f8648403637550b0357c9061eab81cc05`, executable SHA256
`5bdf7e55de71daf45ef2676ba1fb0b96fe3529839dc366ae3b02c0516901d2ad`.
It contains the original publisher's public payload signature. It contains no
private key, Core approval, proposal creation, Store receipt or execution proof.

Its transaction index is a prospective locator observed before preparation;
it reserves nothing. The actual browser ceremony must recheck current chain
state before creating any proposal. Mutation tests are synthetic refusal cases.
